description: Autonomous, Persistent RPG World Engine — distributed-first layout separating machine logic from narrative lore.

data.description: Hybrid Storage Layer — the single source of truth for all world state and lore.

lore.description: Human-readable narrative (Markdown). Indexed into ChromaDB for RAG retrieval.

core.description: Canonical world truth. Maintained by Core team only. Read-only for community contributions.
core.codex: World history, cosmology, locations, and primary faction lore.
core.sessions: Official session transcripts and turn logs.

community.description: Community lore packs. Segregated per author handle. Lower RAG priority than core/.

<author-handle>.community.json: Pack manifest — declares all new content and references.

state.description: Machine-readable current world state (JSON). Validated against /schemas/ on every write.

core.description: Primary world state. Only writable by Core MCP servers with authorization token.
core.entities: NPCs, player characters, enemies, and their live attributes.
core.factions: Faction standings, resources, and player relationship scores.

community.description: Community-contributed state extensions. Cannot overwrite core fields.

infrastructure.description: Node Backbone (The Brawn) — databases, network config, and migration scripts.
infrastructure.docker-compose.yml: Spins up PostgreSQL 16 and ChromaDB with Tailscale mesh binding.
infrastructure..env.example: Environment variable template. Copy to .env and fill in credentials.

migrations.description: SQL scripts auto-executed by PostgreSQL on fresh boot (initdb.d mount).
migrations.001_init_world_state.sql: Creates core entity, faction, and session tables.

tailscale.description: Tailscale ACL policies and mesh configuration for split-node deployments.
tailscale.acl.json: Access control list — restricts DB ports to Tailscale mesh only.

mcp-servers.description: The Bridge — Model Context Protocol servers connecting the Inference Node to the Infrastructure Node.

fs-manager.description: Zero-Touch file handler. Validates all writes against JSON Schema before executing CRUD on /data.
fs-manager.server.py: FastAPI MCP server exposing apply_world_update and read_state tools.
fs-manager.validator.py: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 validation layer — the gatekeeper.
fs-manager.tests: Automated test suite covering schema rejection, path traversal prevention, and successful writes.

git-sync.description: Automated version control — commits after each world update with session metadata.
git-sync.tests: Test suite for commit generation and rollback recovery.

schemas.description: Shared JSON Schema contracts (Draft 2020-12) validating all MCP tool payloads and state files.
schemas.apply_world_update.schema.json: Strict input schema for the fs-manager's primary write tool.
schemas.entity.schema.json: Schema for NPC/player entity state objects.

engine.description: Inference Node (The Brain) — pure-Python package housing the DM, Fact-Extractor, and Lorekeeper agents. Does not import Django, touch disk, or call MCP servers; callers are responsible for side effects. Currently scaffolding only — agent entry points raise NotImplementedError pending the Fact-Extractor implementation and backend wiring.
engine.__init__.py: Public API surface — re-exports Config, DMTurnInput, DMTurnResult, WorldContext, and validate/ValidationResult.
engine.types.py: Plain dataclasses defining the engine's contract with callers (no Django models, no ORM coupling).
engine.schema.py: Loads schemas/apply_world_update.schema.json and exposes validate() via the Draft 2020-12 validator.
engine.llm.py: Thin OpenAI client wrapper. Builds a client from a Config; does not read os.environ.

prompts.description: Agent system prompts — separated from agent logic so prompt changes are diffable.
prompts.dm.py: DM_SYSTEM_PROMPT — ported verbatim from backend/api/dm_ai.py during migration.

agents.description: Agent entry points. Streaming is a plain generator protocol so the backend SSE view can consume the same stream_turn() generator without the engine leaking framework concepts.
agents.dm.py: DM agent — run_turn() and stream_turn(). Builds messages from a WorldContext, calls the OpenAI client, yields narrative tokens.
agents.fact_extractor.py: Bridges raw DM narrative to a schema-valid apply_world_update payload. Pure function: text + session context → validated payload (or None when the DM emitted nothing to commit).

dispatch.description: MCP Bridge HTTP clients. Each submodule wraps one MCP server. Agents do not import dispatch modules directly; the caller (backend) orchestrates the agents → dispatch pipeline.
dispatch.__init__.py: Re-exports common entry points (DispatchResult, apply_world_update, commit_snapshot).
dispatch.fs_manager.py: Synchronous HTTP client for fs-manager's /tools/apply_world_update endpoint. Uses httpx with optional client injection for test mocking via MockTransport.
dispatch.git_sync.py: Synchronous HTTP client for git-sync's /tools/commit_snapshot endpoint. Called by the backend after every successful fs-manager write to produce the per-turn git audit trail. Same DispatchResult shape, same httpx.MockTransport-friendly client injection, same trailing-slash URL normalization. 'no_changes' server responses count as ok=True.

engine.README.md: Package overview and the four boundary rules enforced by tests/engine/test_boundaries.py.

sentinel-ui.description: React 19 + Vite + Tailwind v4 frontend. Diegetic design system, World Creation flow, DM Persona system. Talks to the FastAPI backend (backend/) over fetch + SSE; backend-agnostic by design.
sentinel-ui.src: Application source — components, pages, Zustand stores, hooks, and API client.
sentinel-ui.package.json: Workspace package (@sentinel/ui). Declares dev server and build scripts.

backend.description: FastAPI production backend. Serves the Sentinel API on :8001 per ADR 0001 Phase 1. Reads state directly from data/state/*.json, dispatches writes through the engine → fs-manager → git-sync pipeline. No ORM, no Django.
backend.main.py: FastAPI application factory and uvicorn entry point. Mounts route modules and CORS middleware.
backend.config.py: Settings dataclass loaded from infrastructure/.env via python-dotenv. Replaces Django's settings.py.
backend.schemas.py: Pydantic request/response models mirroring the frontend contract (camelCase aliasing).
backend.engine_bridge.py: Adapter that constructs engine.Config from backend.Settings. The one place the backend imports engine.

routes.description: FastAPI route modules — one per endpoint family.
routes.session.py: POST /api/session/new — creates a session and runs the engine intro through the Fact-Extractor → fs-manager pipeline.
routes.stream.py: POST /api/stream — SSE streaming DM turn. Yields token events live, dispatches Fact-Extractor output after the stream closes.

state.description: Read-side and session-metadata helpers over data/state/*.json. Every write goes through engine.apply_world_update (fs-manager); reads are direct JSON loads.
state.world_context.py: load_world_context(data_dir, session_id, recent_turns) → engine.WorldContext assembled from on-disk state files.
state.sessions.py: Session dataclass, read_session() for on-disk loading, write_session() for engine-dispatched writes.

backend.requirements.txt: Python dependencies (fastapi, uvicorn, pydantic, python-dotenv, httpx) plus engine deps (jsonschema, openai).

docs.description: Project documentation and working reference files.
docs.BACKLOG.md: Single source of truth for discovered, deferred, and in-progress work items. Maintained by agents and contributors.

adr.description: Architecture Decision Records — append-only log of cross-cutting decisions, their context, alternatives, and consequences. See docs/adr/README.md for when and how to write one.
adr.0001-data-canonical-source-of-truth.md: Decision: data/state/*.json + data/lore/*.md + git is canonical; Django/Postgres retire in a phased rollout; the engine → fs-manager → git-sync path becomes the real schema gate.

ISSUE_TEMPLATE.lore_entry.md: Lore-Smith template for new NPCs, locations, and codex entries.
ISSUE_TEMPLATE.mcp_tool.md: Technician template for new Python MCP server tools.
ISSUE_TEMPLATE.schema_refinement.md: Architect template for JSON state model updates.

.github.PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md: Standard PR template enforcing contributor pathway declaration.

root.README.md: Project overview, architecture diagram, and bootstrap instructions.
root.CONTRIBUTING.md: Contributor pathways (Lore-Smith, Schema-Architect, Technician) and coding standards.
root.ARCHITECTURE.md: Core vs. Community framework, namespace separation, override hierarchy, and protected fields.
root.folder_structure.json: This file — machine-readable repo manifest for agent and contributor tooling.
